messages:
Maria G.: Morning — quick async check-in (what I did / blockers / today)
what I did: completed KMS rotation dry run for staging, rolled service keys and updated key aliases. Verified pods picked up new aliases for all non-production clusters.
blockers: prod-lifecycle role still missing s3:GetObject on config-bucket (hitting AccessDenied on a couple services). Need IAM policy reviewer to sign off.
today: will open PR for key-policy changes, help Chris debug the inference-cache error, and run a post-rotation smoke at ~11:30 PT.

Chris L.: Thanks — saw the dry run logs. One service errored during alias refresh (inference-cache). Short trace: 
```
2026-03-16T18:02:12Z inference-cache: failed to refresh kms key alias: AccessDenied
```
I can take a deeper look after standup. Suspect role propagation or cross-account trust issue.

Alex S.: Pinging infra/devops to check propagation delays — @Toni R. noticed similar yesterday. Filed INF-451 for tracker. devops-bot: INF-451 created (role propagation delays across accounts)

Toni R.: I see INF-451, thanks Alex. I'll escalate to oncall infra, and add a short-term read-only policy that grants s3:GetObject for config-bucket to prod-lifecycle role so the rollout can continue. Will post policy snippet in the PR. No compliance objections so far, but need to document the fallback.

sec-bot: automated scan alert — temporary credentials found in 1 log file from staging (low severity). Ticket SEC-987 created for creds scrub and rotation.

Maria G.: Good catch sec-bot — I cleaned the log we found and rotated the temporary token in staging. SEC-987 acknowledged. I'll add a follow-up to ensure log redaction is in the post-rotation checklist.

Chris L.: After I check the perms, I'll try a manual alias refresh command: 
```bash
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/apps/inference-cache --target-key-id xxx
```
If that fails with AccessDenied we'll need a quick IAM escalation.

Toni R.: I'll pre-approve the minimal policy change and link the compliance note. If Alex can confirm INF-451 != regression from yesterday's deploy, we can merge the key-policy PR with a canary rollout.

Alex S.: Confirmed — INF-451 looks like propagation lag, not a deploy change. I'll run a canary after PR lands and monitor token-level errors in the console.

Maria G.: Thanks team. Plan: I’ll open PR now with revert steps + smoke checklist, tag @Chris L. for the inference-cache check, @Toni R. for the temporary policy approval. Will run post-rotation smoke at 11:30 PT and report back here. :thumbsup:

Chris L.: 👍 I’ll try the manual refresh at 11:00 and report findings.

Toni R.: Will update INF-451 with progress and attach the temp-policy. ETA 30m.

Maria G.: closing loop — if anyone sees any residual AccessDenied after 12:00 PT ping here and I’ll trigger a rollback plan. Thanks.
